name: Text Encode
description: Turns a prompt into conditioning for the Sampler, with the model's text encoder, and carries the reference pictures of an edit, or the first frame of a clip, to it. Kept while only the sampling changes, so a new seed does not encode the prompt again.

inputs.name: negative_prompt
inputs.label: Negative prompt
inputs.description: What the image should not show. Used only when the Sampler's guidance is not 1.

inputs.name: references
inputs.label: References
inputs.description: Pictures to edit or take from, for a model that edits (FLUX.2 Klein, Qwen-Image Edit). Each goes to the model at most a megapixel, unless Reference size is exact; Resize to Megapixels sets it.

inputs.name: reference_size
inputs.label: Reference size
inputs.description: Auto: the engine scales each reference to at most a megapixel (and the output's area), to a multiple of 16, before the model sees it. Exact: each keeps the size the graph gave it, as ComfyUI's edit does; the sides should be multiples of 16 (Resize to Megapixels does that).

inputs.name: first_frame
inputs.label: First frame
inputs.description: The picture a clip starts from, for an image-to-video model (Wan 2.2 I2V or TI2V). It is scaled to cover the size of Clip and cut from the middle.

inputs.name: clip
inputs.label: Clip
inputs.description: The Empty Video Latent the clip is made from: with a first frame, the size, length and rate the picture is encoded for. Wire the same one to the Sampler.
